summary: Stony Creek lookout in Shoshone County, listed as PTPA: crow's nest (1915), log cabin on pole tower (1928), abandoned in the 1940s; site listed as hike-in.

facts.design: Crow's nest (1915), then a log cabin with a pole tower (1928)
facts.status_note: Abandoned in the 1940s; no source describes what remains at the site

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts lists the site as hike-in; no source describes access today

events.note: Abandoned in the 1940s; sources give the decade only

evidence.supports: Crow's nest in 1915; log cabin on a pole tower in 1928; abandoned in the 1940s
evidence.quote: 1915: crows nest. 1928: log cabin, pole tower. Abandoned 1940s.

evidence.supports: Statewide list records a tower, marked gone
Filed under St. Joe - Clearwater region

notes_for_editor: Both pages agree on 1915, 1928 and the 1940s abandonment. Idaho Fire Lookouts records no documented staffing history, so no staffing fact is given. Elevation is unknown on both pages. Two web searches and a grep of a Potlatch annual report (pot_tpa1931-1932) found nothing about this lookout. A second tower record, data/towers/id/us-id-stony-creek-2.json, exists alongside us-id-stony-creek.json; it was not checked or changed. Agency PTPA is not expanded in either source.
